8250520.en: You hear voices carried by the gentle winds...

8250521.en: I'm looking for a young attendant to hold my reading lamp. Interested?

8250522.en: *sigh* I'm tired... I could use a shoulder to lean on.

8250523.en: You probably think I like taking advantage of people. It's wrong. I only like taking advantage of you.

8250524.en: I couldn't defeat Lou Ye back then, let alone now.

8250525.en: These half-dead cultivators always love to spout their grandiose nonsense.

8250526.en: They say to reflect on yourself three times a day—well, I've used up today's three chances. Time to do something else!

8250527.en: Well, well! If it isn't the big shot from the world!

8250528.en: My humble shack feels so much brighter now that you're here!

8250529.en: Are you... alright? Did someone hurt you?

8250530.en: Come on, give me a smile to cheer me up!

8250531.en: I truly miss those days of reading every book in the land.

8250532.en: I wonder... how has Lou Ye been doing all these years?

8250533.en: (A brilliant golden feather slips from the person's sleeve—it seems to belong to that person from before...)

8252647.en: My mission is to capture the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil and bring it back to the Xiang family for protection. Lately, this monster has been following that mysterious girl with its spider threads. It seems particularly interested in her ability to traverse realms. Ao Yao is prone to adventure and puts herself in danger, which indirectly affects the monster's safety. I must stay vigilant and ensure she doesn't face even the slightest danger. The Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is incredibly wise, but why would it be interested in this girl? Perhaps it wants the secrets between realms? I suspect it's trying to uncover the mysteries of heaven and earth.

8252654.en: Recently, the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has been conversing with a mysterious woman. They seem to get along remarkably well, likely due to their shared intelligence. The monster looks down on everyone else, so why did it engage in deep conversations with this woman alone? This woman appears to be at odds with some mysterious organization and is an extremely dangerous individual. I fear the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil's association with her will lead to trouble. I must find a way to bring it back home. If left to roam freely, it's bound to get into trouble sooner or later.

8252660.en: The Six-Eyed Bright Pupil looks down on everything in this world, yet lately it has approached this icy witch several times. Has it noticed something special about her? I don't believe this witch is native to the world, since the supernatural cold from her body is quite suspicious. The Six-Eyed Bright Pupil must be curious about her identity, hoping to uncover secrets of the Upper Realm through her. But what does it matter if she's from the Upper Realm? Once she fell to this world, all such secrets would thaw like snow. There's something else: the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has grown wary of me. I'll need more methods to subdue it now. This arachnid is truly extraordinary.

8252661.en: Has it noticed something special about her? I don't believe this witch is native to the world, since the supernatural cold from her body is quite suspicious.

8252665.en: There's something else: the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has grown wary of me. I'll need more methods to subdue it now.

8252667.en: Is that truly a person? She looks more like a puppet. The world never ceases to amaze. Yet the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil has taken an interest in this puppet as well. It keeps approaching the puppet, seemingly trying to uncover her nature. I believe the house she built is more intriguing than the puppet herself. That house appears to embody some profound principle, and the monster, being clever and wise, has noticed its mysterious properties. While the puppet often runs off to the Fallen Valley, the monster uses these opportunities to examine the house, and I could observe the monster itself. Unfortunately, it discovered me and attacked me. Fearing to harm it, I held back at every turn, only to watch it make a graceful escape. Indeed, as a monster, the Six-Eyed Bright Pupil is unique; how could it be easy to deal with? I should have shown no mercy.

8252676.en: As the female cultivator disappears into the distance, the cultivator waves his talisman, surrounds himself with whirling winds, and hastily departs. At the same time, several letters flutter in the wind before gently falling to the ground.

8253281.en: I don't want to lose you

8253282.en: You're capable of so much more

8253283.en: You can't uncover divine secrets if you died

8261228.en: Hey, friend, I've been watching you for a while. Hold on! I discovered this mystic realm, and you can't enter it!

8261229.en: *sigh* All I really need is someone who understands me by my side.

8261230.en: Come visit me often when I return to this world!

8261231.en: You know, living without regrets is all I really need.

8261232.en: The world is like a reflection in water—shattered at the slightest ripple without a shred of truth to its name.

8261233.en: *sigh* When I left this time, my father was so angry that his beard went crooked.

8261235.en: Want to go on an adventure with me? We'll split everything 50-50!

8261236.en: Who hurt you? Let's teach them a lesson together!

8261237.en: I used to live in the Dragon Palace. It was an incredibly beautiful place, shimmering with countless dancing lights and shadows.

8261238.en: The power of the River Chart is truly boundless—it revealed to me how the different planes of the universe can be interconnected.

8261255.en: Even the most scorching flames cannot thaw a frozen heart.

8261256.en: What took you so long? I've been waiting for days!

8261257.en: I never thought anyone would care for me genuinely.

8261258.en: I worry that my frost energy might harm those around me...

8261259.en: The Everfrost is so vast and empty, without a single sign of life...

8261260.en: Tell me, even with this frost energy within me, could I still do something for the world?

8261261.en: You're destined for great things, so why do you keep visiting someone like me?

8261262.en: Ice, snow, ice, snow. You get tired of it pretty quickly.

8261263.en: Don't try to act tough when facing powerful foes out there!

8261264.en: After leaving the Upper Realm, I drifted through the endless dimensional void. It was empty and cold there, completely devoid of life...

8261265.en: When the world drew me in, I thought I glimpsed a ray of hope. But when I finally set foot on solid ground, I found only deeper darkness waiting for me.

10311118.en: The Origin Box has been improved since your last visit.

10311120.en: You return to the Origin Box, but suddenly there's a thunderous crash from ahead. The massive structure crumbles into pieces, scattering debris everywhere...

10311121.en: The Origin Box was connected to {name|B}'s very life force. Now that it has collapsed, {name|B} will likely never return here...

10311122.en: Sigh. There's still so much I don't understand.

10311123.en: *sigh* The ways of the world and its people... they're so hard to grasp!

10311124.en: Alas. Why do people get offended by everything I say?

10311125.en: Say... why do humans show love by pressing their lips together?

10311126.en: *sigh* Human flesh is so soft and squishy... not sturdy at all.

10311127.en: The Upper Realm may be vast and boundless, but to me, it's nothing more than an exquisite prison.

10311128.en: Are you afraid of me? I tend to make trouble without meaning to...

10311129.en: I wonder what kind of life I would have led if I hadn't resisted...

10311130.en: You're not feeling well? Quick, come in and rest!

10311131.en: My creator is always on guard against me. His eyes are full of suspicion and fear...

10311132.en: My creator... not only does he want complete control over me, he wants to control everything...

10311140.en: The energy within stirs slightly as you sense something. When you turn around, you catch a glimpse of a woman peeking out from behind cover—seeing your gaze, she quickly ducks back into hiding.

10311141.en: I-it's me... I wasn't following you on purpose—no, wait, maybe I was... Actually... you haven't visited in so long, and I was worried... I just wanted to see how you were doing.

10311142.en: And... this is a gift for you! If... if you have time, would you come visit me at the Origin Box? I-I'll always be there waiting for you!

10311143.en: {name|B} frantically blurts all this out, thrusts a gift into your hands, then turns and hurries away with a blushing face.

10311144.en: You ignore the woman following behind you. After trailing you for a while, she lets out a soft sigh and turns to leave.

10311145.en: H-hello there. What a coincidence meeting you here. I was out looking for something for you... No, I mean, I just wanted to observe how people interact in crowded places.

10311146.en: You must be busy; go on ahead! Don't waste time here! I-I need to leave too!

10311147.en: Oh my! I was traveling nearby when I saw some cultivators fighting over this thing, but they all ended up falling unconscious. Since they couldn't use it anymore, I brought it for you—I think there's candy inside!

10311148.en: Seeing you lost in thought in her home, {name|B} brings an incense burner from the inner chamber and lights it beside you. A gentle breeze carries the fragrance through the air, filling the space with a soothing aroma that calms the mind and lifts the spirit. She kneels quietly by your side, keeping you company.

10311149.en: Why are you spacing out like that? What's on your mind? Your adventures across the realms must have strained your divine thoughts—that's why I lit this Dreamy Incense; it helps restore them!

10314001.en: Immortal, the Nether Beasts are running rampant, and our people are struggling to survive. We can no longer produce any Enigmatic Stones!

10314002.en: Unless... (A golden flash glints in the handmaiden's eyes as she secretly assesses you with an unknown art.)

10314003.en: Unless a worthy Transcendent cultivator would risk their life for us humans and eliminate the Nether Beasts... then perhaps we could spare some Enigmatic Stones as a reward!

10314004.en: *giggle*... Hey, Immortal, your {grade|A} cultivation just won't cut it! You may train near the Cultivator Alliance and break through to the next realm first!

10314005.en: Your radiance shines like the brightest moon among us humans! From now on, you shall be an honored guest of the Manual Pavilion. Allow me to guide you to where those vile Nether Beasts dwell.
